changelog:
Version 7.8.60

New

  • Cache Manager: revalidate or clear one page, one content type or the whole cache, from the admin bar on any page, the APO menu, or Settings → Performance — it stays available even after the main plugin is removed.
  • Turn off / Turn on APO and Remove APO completely.

Fixes

  • When a page is trashed, unpublished or moved to a new address, the cached copy at its old address is removed, so search engines no longer see a page that should be gone.
  • Full Reset keeps the public files that pages still reference.
